source: Chrome DevTools MCP network observation; selected observed GET requests replayed in browser for structural extraction
schemaNotes: These are observed value types, not JSON Schema or a guaranteed API contract.
Array items describe the first observed item only; later variants may differ.
unobserved means the array was empty; null means only null was sampled.
No cookies, token values, user profile values, post bodies, grades, or signed media URLs are included.
pageId and reqid are session-local locators and cannot be reused after the browser session.
